# Donor CRM with Pledge Tracking

I'll create a comprehensive donor management system with pledge tracking capabilities.

```python
import streamlit as st
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import List, Optional
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from enum import Enum

class DonorType(Enum):
    INDIVIDUAL = "Individual"
    CORPORATION = "Corporation"
    FOUNDATION = "Foundation"
    ORGANIZATION = "Organization"

class PledgeStatus(Enum):
    PENDING = "Pending"
    PARTIAL = "Partially Paid"
    PAID = "Paid in Full"
    OVERDUE = "Overdue"
    CANCELLED = "Cancelled"

class PaymentMethod(Enum):
    CASH = "Cash"
    CHECK = "Check"
    CREDIT_CARD = "Credit Card"
    BANK_TRANSFER = "Bank Transfer"
    ONLINE = "Online Payment"

@dataclass
class Payment:
    payment_id: str
    amount: float
    date: datetime
    method: PaymentMethod
    notes: str = ""

@dataclass
class Pledge:
    pledge_id: str
    donor_id: str
    amount: float
    date_created: datetime
    due_date: datetime
    campaign: str
    status: PledgeStatus
    payments: List[Payment] = field(default_factory=list)
    notes: str = ""
    
    @property
    def amount_paid(self) -> float:
        return sum(p.amount for p in self.payments)
    
    @property
    def amount_remaining(self) -> float:
        return self.amount - self.amount_paid
    
    @property
    def is_overdue(self) -> bool:
        return (datetime.now() > self.due_date and 
                self.amount_remaining > 0 and 
                self.status not in [PledgeStatus.PAID, PledgeStatus.CANCELLED])

@dataclass
class Donor:
    donor_id: str
    name: str
    donor_type: DonorType
    email: str
    phone: str
    address: str
    date_added: datetime
    tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    notes: str = ""
    
    @property
    def total_pledged(self) -> float:
        pledges = [p for p in st.session_state.pledges if p.donor_id == self.donor_id]
        return sum(p.amount for p in pledges)
    
    @property
    def total_donated(self) -> float:
        pledges = [p for p in st.session_state.pledges if p.donor_id == self.donor_id]
        return sum(p.amount_paid for p in pledges)
    
    @property
    def outstanding_balance(self) -> float:
        return self.total_pledged - self.total_donated

            Donor("D002", "Acme Corp", DonorType.CORPORATION, "giving@acme.com",
                  "555-0102", "456 Business Ave", datetime.now() - timedelta(days=180),
                  ["Corporate Partner"], "Annual corporate giving"),
            Donor("D003", "Sarah Johnson", DonorType.INDIVIDUAL, "sarah@email.com",

        ]
        
        sample_pledges = [

                       Payment("PAY001", 2500.00, datetime.now() - timedelta(days=50),
                              PaymentMethod.CHECK, "First installment")
                   ]),
            Pledge("P002", "D002", 25000.00, datetime.now() - timedelta(days=90),
                   datetime.now() - timedelta(days=10), "Building Fund",
                   PledgeStatus.OVERDUE, [
                       Payment("PAY002", 10000.00, datetime.now() - timedelta(days=80),
                              PaymentMethod.BANK_TRANSFER, "Initial payment")
                   ]),
            Pledge("P003", "D001", 1000.00, datetime.now() - timedelta(days=30),

def get_donor_by_id(donor_id: str) -> Optional[Donor]:
    """Get donor by ID"""
    for donor in st.session_state.donors:
        if donor.donor_id == donor_id:
            return donor
    return None

def get_pledge_by_id(pledge_id: str) -> Optional[Pledge]:
    """Get pledge by ID"""
    for pledge in st.session_state.pledges:
        if pledge.pledge_id == pledge_id:
            return pledge
    return None

def update_pledge_status(pledge: Pledge):
    """Update pledge status based on payments and due date"""
    if pledge.amount_remaining <= 0:
        pledge.status = PledgeStatus.PAID
    elif pledge.is_overdue:
        pledge.status = PledgeStatus.OVERDUE
    elif pledge.amount_paid > 0:
        pledge.status = PledgeStatus.PARTIAL
    else:
        pledge.status = PledgeStatus.PENDING
